project_3d_vertices_to_image_plane: build a python module to project 3D vertex positions onto the camera image plane using intrinsic and extrinsic matrices
project_vertices_with_camera_coords: build a python module to project 3D vertices to pixel space and return camera-space coordinates for rendering
transform_with_distortion: build a python module to project 3D vertices with lens distortion coefficients and field of view parameters
transform_with_extrinsic_matrix: build a python module to project 3D vertices using a camera extrinsic Rt matrix instead of separate campos and camrot
transform_with_intrinsic_matrix: build a python module to project 3D vertices using a full 3x3 intrinsic K matrix instead of separate focal and principal point
